component.name: Rustroom
component.summary: A RAW photo editor with a catalog

description.p: Rustroom is a complete darkroom for your RAW files: a Library to import, sort, rate and find your photos, and Develop to edit them — with masks, AI selections, retouching, HDR and panorama merges, tethered shooting, a map, print and export.
Your files are never changed: edits are kept separately beside them. Open source, no subscription, no account.

Rustroom now tells you when a newer version is out, in the status bar. Hide it for this run, or turn the check off for good with Don't show again or in Settings, Behaviour. The status bar's controls fit a narrow window better.
